values.note: Closed for the rest of the 2026 season after August flood damage; no reopening date announced. The owners lost their reservation log in the flood.

note: Private family-owned, 40 acres along the Whitewater River (Connersville); daily/weekly + seasonal. Largest sites are tight (longest documented rig 24 ft) - a 23-ft rig fits but confirm site length at booking. Facebook-only web presence. Camper-reported rate: $40 a night in June 2026 (RV Life review); the park has no web page. --Claude
summary: Changed status open->temporarily closed (August 2026 flood, rest of season); added camper-reported $40 and phone booking. Rate and closure are secondary sources.
flags: CLOSED: WKRC, 2026-08-31: flood waters earlier in August left 'extensive damage'; the campground and Whitewater River Adventures are shut for the rest of the season. RV Life, stay 10/2026: 'Campground is closed down due to floods in August: Called looking for a campsite for a few months. A very kind lady told me there was nothing available as there were no hookups available for the rest of the season due to the flooding'. No reopening date found; Facebook returns HTTP 400 to me, so I could not read any operator post about 2027. Google doesn't mark it closed.

GATE: $40 camper-reported (June 2026, July 2025), under $50. No posted rate, no engine (RoverPass isBookable false). GS status not stated; a 2021 RV Life stay shows a military discount. Nearest gateway: none within 40 km (Cincinnati 79 km). Family has not stayed. Presence: Google 4.6 from 273 reviews with a phone, Facebook page.

LONG-STAY: possible drop on test 2. Campendium's listing, in the owner's words, says 'daily,weekly,seasonal and permenant camping'. RV Life stay 6/2026, headlined 'There's a lot of people that live at the campground': 'The staff was super friendly. Very old school though. You cannot book online. Several campsites were very loud very late on Friday night. Lots of women screaming until 3am.' Imagery shows dense settled units with sheds and roofs in the central cluster and south. If this is long-stay in character, test 2 fails: no posted nightly rate and no engine. Test 4 share not measurable; Campendium claims 60 sites, AllStays 39, neither is the operator.
REVIEWS: Google mostly warm: 'Great campsites with a comfortably large site' (2 months ago), 'Owners and staff are over the top' (same). I read 5 of 273, none negative.
PHONE: stored 765-309-3116 (also on Campendium) vs Google and RoverPass (765) 825-4885. Couldn't tell which is current.

FIT: the note's 'longest documented rig 24 ft' rests on one Campendium reviewer's rig (May 2023), not a site limit. RV Life shows a motorhome at site 37 and fifth wheels at pull-through site 43 (2021). Left in the note because I found no operator statement, but it looks overcautious.

WATER: stored 'riverview'. Imagery at about 1 m/px: the east-most units of the main cluster stand about 35-60 m from the river through a thin tree line (scale estimated; flood damage may have changed this). No operator site map. Possible re-audit once it reopens.
PIN: stored 39.61888,-85.14691 is on SR 121 at the entrance; the main RV cluster is about 235 m east. Address 1614 IN-121.
